title: Drinking Water — Specification
titleHi: पीने का पानी — विशिष्‍टि
qcoOrder: Uniform Water Quality Standards across Municipal & Jal Jeevan Mission utilities
scope: Prescribes the acceptable and permissible requirements and limits for essential characteristics and desirable parameters of drinking water supplied through municipal piped networks and rural water supply schemes.
scopeHi: यह मानक नगर पालिकाओं और जल जीवन मिशन द्वारा आपूर्ति किए जाने वाले नल के पीने के पानी की गुणवत्ता और शुद्धता के मापदंड तय करता है।

keyTests.name: pH Value
keyTests.parameterLimit: Acceptable: 6.5 to 8.5

keyTests.name: Total Dissolved Solids (TDS)
keyTests.parameterLimit: Acceptable: 500 mg/l max (Permissible: 2000 mg/l)

keyTests.name: Fluoride and Nitrate
keyTests.parameterLimit: Fluoride: 1.0 mg/l max; Nitrate: 45 mg/l max

markingRequirements: Used for laboratory compliance certification reports and municipal water audits.
consumerTips: If your tap water TDS is below 300 mg/L with normal pH, simple UV/UF filtration is adequate without heavy RO water waste.
industryGuidelines: Baseline standard for water treatment plants across Jal Jeevan Mission.

clauses.title: Bacteriological Quality
clauses.content: Water shall not contain E. coli or thermotolerant coliform bacteria in any 100 ml sample.
clauses.contentHi: किसी भी 100 मिलीलीटर नमूने में ई. कोलाई बैक्टीरिया नहीं होना चाहिए।

keyTests.name: Flexing Resistance
keyTests.parameterLimit: Zero crack growth > 4 mm

keyTests.name: Chemical Resistance
keyTests.parameterLimit: Tensile strength retention ≥ 80%

markingRequirements: Molded on upper calf: IS 12254, ISI mark, CM/L number, Boot size.
consumerTips: Ensure industrial gumboots have the authentic ISI stamp on the upper rim.
industryGuidelines: No banned phthalate plasticizers or low-grade scrap permitted.

clauses.title: Waterproof Integrity
clauses.content: Tested for water-tightness under 15 kPa air pressure while immersed.
clauses.contentHi: पानी में डुबोने पर कोई बुलबुला नहीं निकलना चाहिए।

demoNotice: SAMPLE/DEMO DATA — Modeled closely after official Bureau of Indian Standards specifications for demonstration purposes.

title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets of Rated Voltage up to 250 V and Current up to 16 A — Specification
titleHi: 250 V तक के वोल्टेज और 16 A तक के करंट के लिए प्लग और सॉकेट — विशिष्‍टि
scope: Covers plugs and fixed or portable socket-outlets for AC only, rated from 2.5 A up to 16 A / 250 V for household and commercial electrical installations.
scopeHi: यह घरों और कार्यालयों में प्रयुक्त होने वाले 6A और 16A 3-पिन प्लग और सॉकेट के आयाम, इन्सुलेशन और सुरक्षा शटर मानकों को नियंत्रित करता है।

keyTests.name: Safety Shutter Engagement Test
keyTests.description: Ensures foreign objects cannot enter live contacts.
keyTests.parameterLimit: 1 mm probe must not touch live parts under 20 N force

keyTests.name: Temperature Rise Test
keyTests.description: Tested at 1.25 times rated current for 1 hour.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Terminal temp rise ≤ 45 K

markingRequirements: Indelibly stamped: IS 1293, ISI logo, CM/L number, Rated Voltage (250V), Rated Current (6A or 16A), Terminal markings (L, N, E).
consumerTips: Never use ungrounded 2-pin plugs on metal-cased appliances; use ISI 3-pin plugs.
industryGuidelines: Brass terminals must pass mercurous nitrate stress corrosion test.

clauses.title: Live Part Contact Protection
clauses.content: Sockets shall prevent access to live parts when a plug is withdrawn.
clauses.contentHi: प्लग निकालने पर सॉकेट के शटर स्वतः बंद होने चाहिए।

title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
titleHi: पैकेज्ड पेयजल (प्राकृतिक खनिज जल के अलावा) — विशिष्‍टि
qcoOrder: Food Safety and Standards (Packaging) Regulations & Mandatory BIS Certification
scope: Prescribes the requirements and methods of sampling and testing for packaged drinking water filled in hermetically sealed food-grade containers of various capacities (pouches, bottles, jars, cans).
scopeHi: यह मानक सीलबंद बोतलों और जार में बेचे जाने वाले पैकेज्ड पीने के पानी के भौतिक, रासायनिक और माइक्रोबायोलॉजिकल सुरक्षा मानकों को निर्धारित करता है।

keyTests.name: Microbiological Sterility Testing
keyTests.description: Tests for Total Coliforms, E. coli, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Yeast & Mould.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Zero (Absent) per 250 ml sample for all pathogen classes

keyTests.name: Total Dissolved Solids (TDS)
keyTests.description: Measures dissolved mineral content post-filtration and mineralization.
keyTests.parameterLimit: 75 mg/l to 500 mg/l

keyTests.name: Pesticide Residues (Individual & Total)
keyTests.description: GC-MS testing for organochlorine, organophosphorus pesticides.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Individual pesticide < 0.0001 mg/l (0.1 ppb); Total < 0.0005 mg/l (0.5 ppb)

markingRequirements: Container must clearly display the ISI Mark, CM/L License Number, PACKAGED DRINKING WATER in bold caps, FSSAI License Number, Date of packaging, Best Before Date, Batch/Lot number, and Net Quantity.
consumerTips: Always check for the holographic/tamper-evident seal and valid ISI mark before buying water bottles.
Check that the label states Packaged Drinking Water with an active FSSAI and BIS CM/L license number.
industryGuidelines: Every bottling facility must have an in-house NABL-aligned laboratory with a qualified microbiologist and chemist.

clauses.title: Permissible Processing Treatments
clauses.content: Water shall be derived from potable surface/ground source and treated by filtration, demineralization/reverse osmosis, and disinfected via ozonation or UV irradiation.
clauses.contentHi: पानी को आरओ, ओजोनेशन और यूवी विकिरण जैसी स्वीकृत वैज्ञानिक प्रक्रियाओं से रोगाणुमुक्त और शुद्ध किया जाना चाहिए।

title: Personal Protective Equipment — Part 2: Safety Footwear

title: Adhesives for Use with Ceramic, Mosaic and Stone Tiles — Specification
titleHi: सिरेमिक, मोज़ेक और पत्थर की टाइलों के लिए चिपकने वाले पदार्थ — विशिष्‍टि
scope: Covers polymer-modified cementitious adhesives for fixing ceramic, vitrified, mosaic, and natural stone tiles on interior and exterior walls and floors.
scopeHi: यह फर्श और दीवारों पर टाइल्स व पत्थरों को चिपकाने के लिए सीमेंट और पॉलिमर आधारित टाइल एडहेसिव के चिपकाने के सामर्थ्य को नियंत्रित करता है।

keyTests.name: Tensile Adhesion Strength
keyTests.parameterLimit: Type 2: ≥ 1.0 N/mm²; Type 4: ≥ 1.5 N/mm²

keyTests.name: Slip Resistance
keyTests.parameterLimit: Slip ≤ 0.5 mm

industryGuidelines: Polymer redispersible powder content must meet flexibility class S1/S2.

clauses.title: Classification
clauses.content: Adhesives classified Type 1 to Type 5 based on bond strength.
clauses.contentHi: टाइल एडहेसिव को ताकत के अनुसार टाइप 1 से 5 तक वर्गीकृत किया गया है।

title: Safety of Electric Toys
titleHi: विद्युत खिलौनों की सुरक्षा

scopeHi: यह 24V से कम वोल्टेज पर बैटरी या अडैप्टर से चलने वाले इलेक्ट्रॉनिक और रिमोट कंट्रोल खिलौनों की सुरक्षा आवश्यकताओं को कवर करता है।

keyTests.name: Operating Voltage Limit Test

Check that battery compartments require a tool to open.

scopeHi: यह सबस्टेशनों और हाई-वोल्टेज बिजली के पैनलों के पास काम करने वाले कर्मचारियों को बिजली के झटके से बचाने वाली इंसुलेटिंग मैट के मानक तय करता है।

scopeHi: यह सरकारी विभागों और सार्वजनिक संगठनों में पारदर्शी नागरिक चार्टर और लोक शिकायत निवारण प्रणाली (सेवोत्तम मॉडल) के मानक तय करता है।

title: Helmets for Riders of Two-Wheeled Motor Vehicles — Specification
titleHi: दोपहिया मोटर वाहन सवारों के लिए हेलमेट — विशिष्‍टि

scope: Prescribes requirements for protective helmets for everyday use by drivers and passengers of two-wheeled motor vehicles to safeguard against head injuries.
scopeHi: यह दोपहिया वाहन चालकों के लिए सुरक्षा हेलमेट के प्रभाव अवशोषण, वजन सीमा और स्ट्रैप मजबूती के मानकों को अनिवार्य करता है।

scopeHi: यह घरेलू आरओ वाटर प्यूरिफायर में पानी की बर्बादी रोकने (न्यूनतम 40%-60% रिकवरी) और रोगाणु शुद्धिकरण के मानकों को अनिवार्य करता है।

scopeHi: यह मानक 1 लीटर से 15 लीटर क्षमता वाले एल्युमिनियम मिश्र धातु या स्टेनलेस स्टील से बने घरेलू प्रेशर कुकरों के लिए सुरक्षा और गुणवत्ता आवश्यकताओं को निर्दिष्ट करता है।

keyTests.parameterLimit: Within ±10% of declared operating pressure (typically 1.0 kg/cm²)

keyTests.name: Proof Pressure Test
keyTests.description: Body and lid subjected to internal hydrostatic pressure.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Must withstand 2.5 times operating pressure without permanent distortion.

keyTests.description: Container withstands extreme pressure before rupture.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Shall not burst at less than 4.5 times normal working pressure.

keyTests.description: Safety fuse release under excess pressure.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Releases pressure between 1.5 to 2.2 times operating pressure.

keyTests.name: Gasket Release Mechanism
keyTests.description: Controlled release of excess steam downwards away from user.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Operates if vent tube and safety valve are blocked.

markingRequirements: Each pressure cooker must bear the ISI Standard Mark along with License Number (CM/L-XXXXXXXXXX), manufacturer name, capacity in liters, working pressure, and material grade.
consumerTips: Always verify the 7 or 8-digit CM/L license number below the ISI logo using the BIS Care App.
Check that safety valve is metallic fusible alloy certified and gasket is food-grade silicone.
Never buy pressure cookers without the ISI Mark - it is legally mandatory in India.
industryGuidelines: Factory audit required for Scheme-I licensing including raw material chemical testing (IS 21/IS 6911).
Routine batch testing for every 500 units: hydrostatic proof pressure, safety valve release pressure.

clauses.title: Material Specifications
clauses.content: Bodies and lids shall be manufactured from wrought aluminium alloy (IS 21) or austenitic stainless steel AISI 304 (IS 6911). Handles must be heat-resistant phenolic moulding (IS 1300).
clauses.contentHi: ढांचा और ढक्कन IS 21 एल्युमिनियम या IS 6911 स्टेनलेस स्टील 304 से बने होंगे।

clauses.title: Safety Devices & Pressure Relief
clauses.content: Every cooker shall be equipped with at least two independent safety relief mechanisms: a weighted pressure regulator/vent tube and a secondary safety valve.
clauses.contentHi: कुकर में रेगुलेटर वेंट ट्यूब और बैकअप सेफ्टी वाल्व सहित दो स्वतंत्र सुरक्षा उपकरण होने अनिवार्य हैं।

clauses.title: Hydrostatic Proof and Burst Pressure
clauses.content: Body with closed lid shall withstand minimum hydraulic pressure of 250 kPa (2.5 bar) without distortion. Rupture shall not occur below 450 kPa.
clauses.contentHi: कुकर बिना किसी विरूपण के न्यूनतम 250 kPa (2.5 बार) का दबाव सहन करने योग्य होना चाहिए।

demoNotice: SAMPLE/DEMO DATA — Modeled closely after official Bureau of Indian Standards specifications for demonstration purposes.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement (33, 43 and 53 Grade) — Specification
titleHi: साधारण पोर्टलैंड सीमेंट (33, 43 और 53 ग्रेड) — विशिष्‍टि
scope: Covers the manufacture, chemical and physical requirements of ordinary Portland cement in 33 Grade, 43 Grade, and 53 Grade.
scopeHi: यह मानक 33, 43 और 53 ग्रेड के साधारण पोर्टलैंड सीमेंट (ओपीसी) के रासायनिक और संपीड़न सामर्थ्य मानकों को नियंत्रित करता है।

keyTests.name: Compressive Strength (28 Days)
keyTests.parameterLimit: Grade 53: Min 53.0 MPa at 28 days; Grade 43: Min 43.0 MPa

keyTests.name: Initial and Final Setting Time
keyTests.parameterLimit: Initial setting time ≥ 30 min; Final setting time ≤ 600 min

markingRequirements: IS 269, ISI Mark, CM/L number, Grade of cement (e.g. OPC 53), Net weight (50 kg), Week/Month/Year of manufacture.
consumerTips: Never use cement bags older than 90 days from packaging date without re-testing strength.
industryGuidelines: Insoluble residue ≤ 5.0% and total sulfur content (as SO3) ≤ 3.5%.

clauses.title: Compressive Strength
clauses.content: Compressive strength of mortar cubes shall not be less than 53 MPa at 28 days for 53 Grade OPC.
clauses.contentHi: 53 ग्रेड ओपीसी के लिए 28 दिनों में शक्ति 53 MPa से कम नहीं होनी चाहिए।

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — General Requirements
titleHi: घरेलू और समान विद्युत उपकरणों की सुरक्षा — सामान्य आवश्यकताएं
scope: Deals with safety of electrical appliances for household purposes, rated voltage not more than 250V single-phase (electric irons, immersion heaters, mixer grinders, toasters, geysers).
scopeHi: यह मानक घरेलू उपयोग के विद्युत उपकरणों (इलेक्ट्रिक आयरन, वॉटर हीटर, मिक्सी) की सुरक्षा से संबंधित है।

keyTests.name: High Voltage Electric Strength Test
keyTests.description: Tests insulation barrier breakdown between live parts and enclosure.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Withstand 1250V AC (Class I) or 3750V AC (Class II) for 1 minute

keyTests.name: Leakage Current & Earth Continuity
keyTests.description: Verifies protection against electric shock during normal operation.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Earth resistance < 0.1 Ω; Leakage current < 0.75 mA for Class I portable appliances

keyTests.name: Thermal Heating & Abnormal Operation
keyTests.description: Operated at 1.15 times rated power under locked rotor conditions.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Enclosure temp rise must not exceed safe limit (60K for handles)

markingRequirements: Mandatory marking of Rated Voltage (V), Rated Power (W/kW), Model name, Manufacturer name or Trademark, and ISI Standard Mark with CM/L license number.
consumerTips: Check for 3-pin earthed plugs on high wattage heating appliances (irons, geysers, room heaters).
Ensure electric immersion rods have the ISI mark; uncertified rods cause severe shock hazards.
industryGuidelines: 100% routine testing for High Voltage dielectric breakdown and Earth bond continuity on assembly lines.

clauses.title: Protection Against Electric Shock
clauses.content: Appliances shall be constructed so that adequate protection exists against accidental contact with live parts.
clauses.contentHi: उपकरणों में सक्रिय विद्युत भागों के आकस्मिक संपर्क से पूर्ण सुरक्षा होनी चाहिए।

clauses.title: Leakage Current at Operating Temperature
clauses.content: Leakage current shall not exceed 0.75 mA for portable Class I appliances and 0.25 mA for Class II appliances.
clauses.contentHi: क्लास I पोर्टेबल उपकरणों के लिए लीकेज करंट 0.75 mA से अधिक नहीं होना चाहिए।

demoNotice: SAMPLE/DEMO DATA — Modeled closely after official Bureau of Indian Standards specifications for demonstration purposes.

title: Welded Low Carbon Steel Cylinders for Low Pressure Liquefiable Gases — Part 1: Cylinders for LPG
titleHi: कम दबाव वाले द्रवीकृत गैसों के लिए वेल्डेड कम कार्बन स्टील सिलेंडर — भाग 1: एलपीजी सिलेंडर
qcoOrder: Gas Cylinders Rules, 2016 (PESO) & Mandatory BIS Order
scope: Specifies requirements for design, materials, manufacturing process, heat treatment, testing and inspection of refillable welded low carbon steel cylinders of capacity up to 150 liters water capacity for liquefied petroleum gases (LPG).
scopeHi: यह मानक एलपीजी गैस (घरेलू 14.2 किग्रा और व्यावसायिक 19 किग्रा) के लिए 150 लीटर तक जल क्षमता वाले वेल्डेड लो-कार्बन स्टील सिलेंडरों के निर्माण और सुरक्षा परीक्षण को निर्धारित करता है।

keyTests.name: Hydrostatic Stretch Test
keyTests.description: Measures permanent volumetric expansion under test pressure.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Permanent expansion must not exceed 10% of total expansion at 2.5 MPa (25 bar)

keyTests.name: Hydrostatic Burst Pressure Test
keyTests.description: Determines minimum pressure required to rupture the cylinder shell.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Must not burst below 4.5 MPa (45 bar) and failure must occur longitudinally without fragmentation

markingRequirements: Permanent stamping on the stay plate/collar: IS 3196-1, ISI mark, CM/L number, PESO approval mark, Tare weight (kg), Water capacity (L), Test pressure (MPa), Serial number, manufacturer symbol, and Quarter/Year of next statutory re-test.
consumerTips: Check the three stay plates on your LPG cylinder for the clear ISI mark and PESO certification stamp.
Inspect the statutory test expiry date painted on the inner ring (e.g., A-28 means First Quarter of 2028). Never accept an expired cylinder.
industryGuidelines: Micro-alloyed low carbon cylinder steel must strictly conform to IS 6240.

clauses.title: Shell Thickness and Design Stress
clauses.content: The minimum wall thickness of the cylindrical shell shall be calculated such that calculated stress at test pressure does not exceed 80% of minimum guaranteed yield strength.
clauses.contentHi: सिलेंडर की न्यूनतम दीवार की मोटाई इस प्रकार रखी जाएगी कि परीक्षण दबाव पर प्रतिबल मूल धातु की उपज शक्ति के 80% से अधिक न हो।

demoNotice: SAMPLE/DEMO DATA — Modeled closely after official Bureau of Indian Standards specifications for demonstration purposes.

title: Unplasticized PVC Pipes for Potable Water Supplies — Specification
titleHi: पीने के पानी की आपूर्ति के लिए अनप्लास्टिसाइज़्ड पीवीसी पाइप — विशिष्‍टि
qcoOrder: Plumbing and Water Fitting Products (Quality Control) Order
scope: Prescribes requirements for unplasticized polyvinyl chloride (uPVC) pipes for potable water supplies in domestic, agricultural, and municipal plumbing.
scopeHi: यह घरों, खेतों और नगर पालिका में पीने के पानी के वितरण के लिए uPVC पाइपों के दबाव और सुरक्षा मानकों को तय करता है।

keyTests.name: Hydrostatic Pressure Test
keyTests.parameterLimit: No burst or leak at 4.2 times rated pressure for 1 hour

keyTests.name: Lead & Toxic Metal Extraction
keyTests.description: Leaching test for heavy metal stabilizers.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Lead extraction < 0.05 mg/l on third extraction

markingRequirements: Continuous linear marking: IS 4985, ISI mark, CM/L license number, Pipe class, Outer diameter, manufacturer name.
consumerTips: Ensure pipes for drinking water are lead-free uPVC certified under IS 4985.
industryGuidelines: Virgin PVC resin K-value must be between 65 and 68.

clauses.title: Hydrostatic Burst
clauses.content: Pipes shall withstand short-term hydrostatic pressure without bursting.
clauses.contentHi: पाइपों को बिना फटे हाइड्रोस्टेटिक दबाव का सामना करना चाहिए।

title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and including 1100 V — Specification
titleHi: 1100 V तक के कार्यशील वोल्टेज के लिए पीवीसी इन्सुलेटेड केबल — विशिष्‍टि
scope: Covers the requirements for single-core and multi-core PVC insulated and sheathed/unsheathed electrical cables with copper or aluminium conductors for working voltages up to 1100 V AC, widely used in domestic building wiring and industrial panels.
scopeHi: यह मानक 1100 V AC तक के वोल्टेज के लिए तांबे या एल्यूमीनियम कंडक्टर वाले पीवीसी इंसुलेटेड तारों और केबलों की आवश्यकताओं को कवर करता है।

keyTests.name: Conductor Resistance Test
keyTests.description: Measures electrical DC resistance per km at 20°C using Kelvin Double Bridge.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Max resistance e.g. 12.1 Ω/km for 1.5 sq mm class 2 copper conductor

keyTests.name: Flame Retardance Test (Oxygen & Temperature Index)
keyTests.description: Measures burning behavior and self-extinguishing properties.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Oxygen index > 29% for FR/FRLS cables; Temperature index > 250°C

markingRequirements: Cables must have sequential meter marking, IS 694 mark, ISI Logo, CM/L license number, rated voltage (1100V), cable size, and manufacturer trade name.
consumerTips: Never compromise on domestic electrical wiring; counterfeit cables with sub-standard copper cause fires.
Look for continuous laser or ink jet printing along the wire with IS 694, conductor size, and ISI mark.
industryGuidelines: Electrolytic grade bright annealed high-conductivity copper (minimum 99.97% purity conforming to IS 8130) is mandatory.

clauses.title: Conductor Properties and Resistance
clauses.content: Conductors shall consist of annealed high conductivity copper or EC grade aluminium wires conforming to IS 8130.
clauses.contentHi: कंडक्टर IS 8130 के अनुसार उच्च चालकता वाले तांबे या एल्युमिनियम तारों से बने होंगे।

title: Approval Testing of Welders for Fusion Welding — Part 1: Steels
titleHi: फ्यूजन वेल्डिंग के लिए वेल्डरों का अनुमोदन परीक्षण — भाग 1: स्टील्स
scope: Prescribes requirements for welder qualification and approval testing in fusion welding of carbon and alloy steels across all standard welding positions (1G to 6G).
scopeHi: यह संरचनात्मक और पाइप वेल्डिंग में वेल्डरों के कौशल और वेल्ड जोड़ों के परीक्षण (एक्स-रे और बेंड टेस्ट) के मानक तय करता है।

keyTests.name: Visual Examination of Weld Seam
keyTests.parameterLimit: Zero crack, zero lack of fusion, undercut ≤ 0.5 mm

keyTests.name: Radiographic Examination (NDT)
keyTests.parameterLimit: Acceptance level B under ISO 5817

markingRequirements: Welder Qualification Record (WQR) certificate indicating IS 7318-1.
consumerTips: For critical building/bridge fabrication, ensure welders hold active IS 7318 certification.
industryGuidelines: Welder qualification validity is typically 2 years subject to periodic verification.

clauses.title: Test Conditions
clauses.content: Test piece welded according to qualified Welding Procedure Specification.
clauses.contentHi: परीक्षण पीस को योग्य वेल्डिंग प्रक्रिया विनिर्देश के अनुसार वेल्ड किया जाएगा।

title: Safety of Toys — Part 1: Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties
titleHi: खिलौनों की सुरक्षा — भाग 1: यांत्रिक और भौतिक गुणों से संबंधित सुरक्षा पहलू
qcoOrder: Toys (Quality Control) Order, 2020 (Ministry of Commerce & Industry)
scope: Applies to all toys intended for use by children under 14 years of age. Specifies criteria for physical features including sharp edges, points, small parts (choking hazard for under 36 months), cords, and impact resistance.
scopeHi: यह मानक 14 वर्ष से कम उम्र के बच्चों के लिए बने सभी खिलौनों पर लागू होता है और नुकीले किनारों, छोटे हिस्सों (दम घुटने का खतरा) और मजबूती से संबंधित सुरक्षा मानदंड तय करता है।

keyTests.name: Small Parts Cylinder Choking Test
keyTests.description: Components must not fit entirely inside standard test cylinder (31.7 mm dia).
keyTests.parameterLimit: No detachable small parts for toys intended for children under 3 years

keyTests.name: Sharp Edge & Sharp Point Test
keyTests.parameterLimit: Zero hazardous sharp edges or sharp points

keyTests.name: Drop and Impact Test
keyTests.description: Toys dropped 5 times from 850 mm onto concrete slab.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Must not crack, shatter into sharp splinters, or release small parts

markingRequirements: Toys and packaging must display the ISI mark, CM/L number, manufacturer identity, age grading, warning symbols, and maximum battery specifications.
consumerTips: Every toy sold in Indian retail or online must have the ISI mark; importing or selling non-ISI toys is illegal in India.
Check age recommendation labels carefully, especially for toys containing button batteries or small magnets.
industryGuidelines: Chemical compliance under IS 9873 (Part 3) for heavy metal migration is mandatory alongside Part 1.

clauses.title: Small Parts for Children Under 36 Months
clauses.content: Toys intended for children under 36 months of age, and their removable components, shall not fit entirely inside the small parts cylinder.
clauses.contentHi: 36 महीने से कम उम्र के बच्चों के खिलौने टेस्ट सिलेंडर में पूरी तरह नहीं समाने चाहिए।
